propositions: terraform plan fails on main because user_data.sh contains three unescaped ${...} sequences in comments that templatefile() attempts to interpolate as HCL expressions
the three broken interpolations (at lines 92 and 111) reference bash variables PARAMS that are not declared template variables, causing Terraform to reject the ! character in ${!PARAMS[@]}
the defect was introduced by commit ef1a7e66a65d which added shell comment explanations with escaped opening halves ($$) but left closing halves unescaped
all Terraform operations on the configuration are blocked because templatefile() evaluation occurs before -target flags are honored
a regression guard must be added to catch unescaped interpolations referencing undeclared template variables, distinct from valid cases like data_volume_id which are properly unescaped
